programme.title: Hard Quiz
programme.desc: Four experts, four topics, one Big Brass Mug. Tonight's subjects: Millinery, Murriyang (the Parkes Radio Telescope), RuPaul's Drag Race and Pablo Escobar! It's the game show where stealing is the way to win!

programme.title: Spicks and Specks
programme.sub-title: Zoe Coombs Marr, Rhonda Burchmore, Zion Garcia and Brett Blake
programme.desc: Discussing the importance of The Wiggles in Australian cinema are both kinds of guests, Country (Zoe Coombs Marr) and Western (Rhonda Burchmore, Zion Garcia, Brett Blake). Robert Forster performs one of Alan's favourites.

programme.title: New Zealand Spy
programme.desc: Ignoring Boss's orders to rest and recuperate, Michael follows a lead to a Marlborough vineyard. Meanwhile, Sue teams up with a British spy in hope of uncovering valuable information.

programme.title: Dr Karl's How Things Work
programme.desc: In this peep behind Bega's factory doors, Dr Karl learns how cheese is made. and it would appear that he knows more about String Theory, than he does string cheese. (Final)

programme.title: ABC News At Noon
programme.desc: The leading news at lunchtime. Jade Macmillan brings you today's top stories and the latest news as it unfolds with reporters in the community across Australia and around the world reporting on the issues that matter to you.

programme.title: Believe Me
programme.desc: After a police appeal, Worboys is eventually caught and convicted. Carrie waives her anonymity. Sarah and Laila, whose lives have been turned upside down, decide to sue the police.

programme.title: Back Roads
programme.desc: Canowindra might be known as the hot-air ballooning capital of Australia, but there's plenty more going for this town. The Canowindra community is looking to reinvent its future, doing big gestures of kindness along the way.

programme.title: Julia Zemiro's Home Delivery
